Part QU12009 also fits: DRT 3010. *LMR240 / LMR400 This special low-loss SMA male to N MALE extension cable is 240 grade (LMR-240* equivalent loss) low loss shielded for 6, 10, and 15 foot length options, and 400 grade for 25 and 50 foot options. 240 and 400 refer to shielding thickness. The thicker shielding means lower dB loss. 240 grade is .24 inches thick, while .400 is ~.40 inches thick. 400 has less loss. For length up to 15 foot, 240 is more than adequate, but for 25 or 50 foot length, the 400 is recommended. The cable can be used to put an extension between an SMA antenna connector on a LoRa device or Meshtastic radio and an N-female antenna. This antenna is compatible with the RAK V2, Bobcat 300, Nebra Indoor, SenseCAP M1, Kerlink, Linxdot, SyncroB.it, Helium Hotspot, Kerlink, FreedomFi & LongAP, (915 MHz USA and Australia versions + Europe 868 MHz also) but requires an RP-SMA male to N-female coaxial cable to fit, and we carry compatible coaxial cables . This has the same gain as the Bobcat factory antenna and would be a better choice for RAK or Nebra owners. We do recommend RokTape to seal all outdoor connection points.
